lines.text: The mountain behind me just exploded. This is Pompeii.
This morning was ordinary. Fresh bread. A guard dog on his chain.
The ground shook. Here, it always shakes.
A cloud climbs out of it like a pine tree: a tall trunk, then branches.
About eleven thousand people live here. Nobody is ready.
People grab what they can carry, and run.
The baker runs. The soldier runs. The merchant grabs his coins. I grab my cap.
Then the sky starts to fall. Not rain. Stones.
I dive under an awning. It does not hold.
And in the middle of the day, it goes dark. That is part two.
